Oregon State's defense out-rates the opposing offense on a down-to-down basis (-1.52 for San Diego State's offense).

Oregon State owns the stronger opponent-adjusted explosive-play matchup: Oregon State offense vs San Diego State defense +0.43, San Diego State offense vs Oregon State defense -1.22 (explosive-play rate, opponent-adjusted: Oregon State offense #13 of 138, San Diego State defense #36 of 138).

Oregon State owns the stronger opponent-adjusted finishing matchup: Oregon State offense vs San Diego State defense +0.67, San Diego State offense vs Oregon State defense -1.23 (points per scoring opportunity, opponent-adjusted: Oregon State offense #23 of 138, San Diego State defense #46 of 138).
Both offenses and both defenses point to more snaps than an average FBS game (possession environment +1.27).
